cue.zh: 套房里他拿走那杯酒，自称是四个骗子之一，问她还要不要他。
cue.en: In the suite he takes her drink, says he's one of the four, and asks if she still wants him.

A.en: I keep him, win the beach flag, then test him.

B.zh: 我后退半步，说我改选Wes，明早找他当面拆穿。
B.en: I step back, switch to Wes, and confront him tomorrow.
